answer_1.quote: We conduct our experiments on the negotiation datasets, including PersuasionForGood (P4G) and CraigslistBargain (CB) ... to generate negotiation dialogue responses.

answer_2.quote: We utilize two types of evaluation methodologies: goal-based metrics (average turn (AT), success rate (SR), Sale-to-List Ratio (SL)) and quality-based metrics (Non-repetition (N-Rep), Coherence (Coh), Empathy (Emp), Persuasiveness (Pers)).

answer_3.quote: Our evaluation is powered by LLMs ... we compare LLM‑based evaluator scores with human annotations and report Spearman correlations.
methods: pairwise A/B comparison using LLM judges

answer_4.quote: We sample 50 dialogues generated by DMNA ... these dialogues are then annotated by 3 human annotators ... using the same standard as the LLM‑based evaluator.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rate each dialogue on the four quality dimensions using a five‑point scale.
